processing.sampling: one shared nearest-neighbor grid; alpha threshold 160; nearest palette RGB
processing.pulseCanvas: 32px art centered in padded 64x32 canvas, not stretched
processing.materialLoop: one low-contrast slice, runtime frame 0, shared -floor(simulationTime*80) mod 32 source phase; ordinary interior-column edges, no bright caps
processing.cropping: integer floor/clamp source cropX and cropWidth; round material length once; cropped left starts at command x/y; Phaser compensates rotated cropX*scaleX
processing.dissolve: deterministic ordered pixel erosion of compressed source, no RNG
